test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts and decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

All cups are plates.

All plates are glasses.

Conclusions:

(I) Some plates are not cups.

(II) All cups are glasses.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
**Statements**:

All cups are plates.

All plates are glasses.

The least Possible venn diagram is given:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/455dc59c38d601a7dd3b2d26716e8f26880f250bc19fd8a186e0b6c4a970a1f8.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some plates are not cups - **False**(because, all cups are plate is given so, it can be possible only).

(II) All cups are glasses - **True**(because, all cups are plates and all plates are glasses, it implies that all cups are glasses as well).

Thus, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
